name: 03755 · Hanover, NH
findings: ZIP 03755 (Hanover) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03755 (Hanover) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03755 (Hanover) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
